penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Setting up and maintaining a resilient auth-rotation layer for Salesforce + GitHub Actions requires per-customer credential management, integration work, and ongoing Salesforce-platform-specific configuration — not deliverable fully autonomously.

rationale: The buyer is a named, budget-holding segment (Salesforce DevOps engineers at companies paying enterprise Salesforce + CI/CD tooling costs), and the pain is recurring and costly. However, a monitoring or auth-rotation service for Salesforce + GitHub Actions requires per-customer Salesforce credential access and ongoing maintenance tied to Salesforce platform update cycles — each new customer is a bespoke integration, not a self-serve signup. After the human fulfillment penalty, total drops to 4.2, below the validate threshold. Operational_autonomy at 5 would also fail the build gate (minimum 7) even if the total were higher.
solution_plan: Not recommended for this factory. While the pain is real and the buyer is clear, building an autonomous auth-monitoring or auth-rotation service for Salesforce + GitHub Actions requires per-org credential management and Salesforce API integration depth that can't be delivered hands-off by Claude. Each new customer would need custom setup work by a human with Salesforce admin access. A solo non-technical operator cannot build this autonomously. Pass.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy build gate (score 5, minimum 7). Total 4.2 below min_total_to_validate of 5.5.
